facts.text: MultiWiiNode is an rclcpp::Node constructed with the node name "multiwii".
main initializes rclcpp, spins one MultiWiiNode and shuts rclcpp down.
The constructor declares device_path (default /dev/ttyUSB0) and baud (default 115200), constructs fcu::FlightController and calls connect(device_path, baud).

The constructor advertises eight relative-name SensorDataQoS publishers: imu/data_raw (sensor_msgs::msg::Imu), imu/mag (MagneticField), local_position/pose (PoseStamped), rc/in (mavros_msgs::msg::RCIn), motors (mavros_msgs::msg::RCOut), battery (BatteryState), global_position/rel_alt (std_msgs::msg::Float64) and state (mavros_msgs::msg::State).
The constructor subscribes to the relative topics rc/override and rc/override/raw with mavros_msgs::msg::OverrideRCIn and SystemDefaultsQoS.
The constructor block that registers the RC override subscriptions contains no service server registration.
rc_override_AERT1234 forwards channels 0 through 7 to fcu->setRc in AERT (Aileron, Elevator, Rudder, Throttle) or RPYT (Roll, Pitch, Yaw, Throttle) order.
rc_override_raw copies every received channel into std::vector<uint16_t> and calls fcu->setRc(channels).
The constructor creates a 100 ms wall timer that calls onState.
onState publishes state.armed from fcu->isArmed() on the state topic; the other State fields are left at their defaults.
onRc publishes the received rc.channels on rc/in.
onMotor copies every motor.motor value into the motors RCOut channels.
onAttitude converts roll, pitch and yaw from degrees to radians, builds a quaternion from them, publishes the orientation in local_position/pose and broadcasts a TF child frame attitude.
onAltitude publishes altitude.altitude on global_position/rel_alt; the code comments that the value is in meters.

onImu constructs ImuSI(imu, 512.0, 1/4.096, 0.092, 9.80665), publishes imu_si.acc as linear_acceleration and deg2rad(imu_si.gyro) as angular_velocity in imu/data_raw, and publishes imu_si.mag * 1e-6 in imu/mag.
onAnalog copies analog.vbat and analog.amperage into battery.voltage and battery.current.
The only flight-controller writes in this range are the two RC override callbacks' fcu->setRc calls; onState only reads fcu->isArmed().
The multiwii_msgs package generates SendMSPRawMessage and ReceiveMSPRawMessage service definitions.

operator_required.name: publish_rc_override
operator_required.reason: the clone forwards channels 0..7 unchanged to fcu->setRc in AERT/RPYT order and states no valid RC pulse or normalized range; the site must supply the eight channel bounds

operator_required.name: publish_rc_override_raw
operator_required.reason: the clone forwards the received vector unchanged to fcu->setRc(vector<uint16_t>) and states no valid channel count or value range; the site must supply the channel bounds

safe_state.description: No acknowledged safe state is available: the node creates no arm, disarm or stop service and its only command inputs are the publish-only rc/override topics; a software latch cannot confirm that the flight controller stopped.
